text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Eight dead and 25 wounded in car bomb attack in El Biar.

- Cabinet adopts additional mini-budget to offset extra expenditures. Breakdown of the 29 billion dinars ($500 million) includes 11 billion for civil service salary increases, eight billion to underwrite debts and four billion for planned local elections.
- Car bomb kills three and injures 25 in El Biar.
- President Liamine Zeroual tells commission in charge of monitoring elections that "political moves to find a way out of the institutional crisis are about to get result."
- New terrorist action on Algiers heights: car bomb in El Biar kills eight and wounds 24.
- Policeman and civilian killed, two police seriously wounded, in ambush in La Glaciere district of Algiers.
- Death of eight people in car bomb attack raises questions.
- Foreign operators show interest in relaunching cooperation with local firms.
- Algerian president inducts commission in charge of monitoring elections.
